name: Dark Thaumaturgy (Path of Phobos) — 1 Basic — Spook

system.description: Conjures vivid hallucinations of an imminent, inescapable attack tailored to the victim's fears. Win a Mental Challenge and the target must flee the area at once; a Cainite victim must also win a Courage Virtue Test against three Traits or fall into Rötschreck.
